transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose it's work. The district recently decided to roll out this new bilingual social-emotional learning program, and they just... put it on my plate. Along with my regular teaching duties. 

I mean, I'm still getting through the days. But... I just feel so wound up lately. And discouraged. It's really not like me. I've even started putting off my lesson plans and... ignoring emails that I usually handle right away. It's just... a lot.
Are you still enjoying the things you used to like doing?
I suppose so. I haven't really... noticed a difference with that. I think I still enjoy things fine.
Are you avoiding any social interactions that you normally wouldn't have a problem with?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed myself doing that. I still see people.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. I think it's been about the same.
Have you been worrying more than usual about things lately?
Not really. Just... the normal amount, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
No, my energy has been fine. I haven't felt particularly tired.
Have you been feeling more irritable than usual lately?
I don't think so. I haven't really found myself getting angry or... snapping at anyone. So, no.
Are you having trouble finding pleasure in things that you normally enjoy?
No, I don't think so. I still... enjoy the things I usually do. I haven't noticed any change there.
Have you been feeling guilty or worthless about anything lately?
No. I don't... I haven't felt like that.
Have you been feeling anxious more often than usual lately?
Anxious? Um... no. Not really. I haven't noticed feeling like that.
Have you been having any physical symptoms like headaches or muscle tension lately?
No... I haven't had any of that. Physically, I feel fine, I suppose. Just... normal.
Have you been having trouble stopping your mind from thinking about work or the new program when you're not there?
No, I don't think so. When I leave the school, I usually just... leave it there. I don't really dwell on it at home.
Do you feel overwhelmed by the new responsibilities at work?

I suppose... yes, a little. It's just... well, the district decided to add this bilingual social-emotional learning rollout to my schedule. On top of my regular teaching. I mean, I still get through the day, but... I don't know, I just feel wound up. And discouraged. It's not really like me. I've even started putting off my lesson plans and... and emails. Things I used to just handle without thinking twice about it.
How long have you been feeling wound up and discouraged since the new program was added to your workload?
About... five months, I think. Since the middle of the school year when they gave me the role.
Are you avoiding going to work or certain tasks at work because of feeling overwhelmed?

I'm still going in. I mean, I'm teaching and meeting my basic responsibilities. But... I suppose I have been pushing back some of my planning deadlines. And... a few colleagues have had to remind me about tasks I used to just get done reliably. So... yes, a little, I guess.
Have you noticed any significant problems in your relationships with colleagues, students, or family members since you started feeling overwhelmed with work?
Not really... no. I mean, I still talk to my husband. And the students are fine. I just... I keep to myself a bit more at school lately, but no big problems.
Do you find yourself thinking about work or the new program a lot when you're trying to relax or fall asleep?
Not really, no. Um... I try to just leave it at the school when I go home. I haven't really noticed it keeping me up or anything.
Have you noticed any problems with your daily routine or activities outside of work since you started feeling overwhelmed?
No, not really. I mean, my routine is pretty much the same. I just do what I need to do around the house. It's... it's fine.
Are you doing fewer things at work or avoiding certain work tasks because they feel too stressful or overwhelming?

I mean... I'm still teaching. Doing the basic things I need to do. I guess... I have pushed back a few planning deadlines lately. And, um, maybe needed a reminder or two from the other teachers about tasks I usually just handle on my own. But... I'm still getting my job done.
Are you avoiding any specific tasks or responsibilities at work because you feel overwhelmed by them?
Um... like I said, I'm just a little behind on some of the planning. But no... there isn't anything specific I'm just avoiding. I'm still handling my responsibilities.
